text: Namaste! Ye hai Shubhora — aapka AI business assistant. Is video mein dekhiye, kaise ek hi link par aapka poora business online aa jata hai — digital visiting card, website, AI assistant, roz ke poster, aur saare leads, ek hi jagah.

Chhote business ke customer chaar jagah haath se nikal jaate hain. Paper ka card ek hafte mein phenk diya jata hai. Website na ho, to online bharosa nahi banta. Raat ko aaya sawaal subah tak ruk jata hai — tab tak customer kahin aur se khareed leta hai. Aur roz post karne ka time kisi ke paas nahi hota.

Shubhora mein ek link paanch kaam karta hai. Digital V-Card — call, WhatsApp, save contact, map aur UPI. Usi link par poori website. AI assistant, jo din-raat card aur WhatsApp par jawab deta hai. Roz ka poster aur video, jo apne aap post hota hai. Aur har enquiry, leads aur CRM mein save.

Customer ko kya milta hai? Card par photo, products — MRP aur offer price ke saath — gallery, reviews, timing aur map. Wahi details computer par poori website ban jaati hain. AI assistant customer ki bhasha mein jawab deta hai. Roz subah naya poster banta hai, aur apne aap post hota hai. Har call aur WhatsApp, lead ban kar save hota hai. Aur AI Studio se product photo aur video ad — jitna banaiye, utna hi dijiye.

Ye har tarah ke business ke liye hai — doctor aur clinic, dukaan aur kirana, salon, restaurant, property dealer, insurance, IT aur freelancers, aur direct sellers. 78 professions ke ready designs hain, barah look mein. Saare designs shubhora dot com slash templates par dekhiye.

Card banana bahut aasaan hai. Pehle, mobile number aur naam se free sign up kariye. Phir apne products daliye — photo, naam, MRP aur offer price. AI ek minute se kam mein aapka card likh deta hai. Phir link WhatsApp par share kariye, aur QR counter par lagaiye — har tap ek lead hai. Poora tareeka paanch minute ke Hindi video mein hai, aur app shubhora dot com slash app se install hota hai.
Apne phone ke camera se ye QR code scan kariye. Pehla — sample cards. Doosra — paanch minute ka Hindi tutorial. Teesra — seedha apna free card banaiye.

Plans simple hain. Free plan hamesha ke liye free hai — 1,499 rupaye ki value ka digital V-Card, koi card details nahi, koi hidden charge nahi. Growth plan 2,999 rupaye mahine ka, GST shamil — website, WhatsApp AI, roz ke poster aur video, auto-posting, aur saare AI tools. Aur isse zyada kuch bhi chahiye — apna software, customization ya automation — to Custom Solutions, aapki zarurat ke hisaab se, dedicated manager ke saath.

Paper card aur Shubhora V-Card mein farak saaf hai. Photos, products aur price. Bina reprint ke badlav. Computer par website. Raat ko bhi jawab. Har enquiry ka record. Aur WhatsApp par ek tap mein share. Aur shuru karne ka kharcha — kuch nahi.

To der kis baat ki? Aaj hi shubhora dot com par apna free card banaiye. Aur chahein, to ise doosron tak pahuncha kar apna business bhi shuru kar sakte hain. Koi sawaal ho, to jisne ye video bheja hai, unse poochiye.

Ab doosra hissa — Shubhora partner opportunity. Registration free hai. Koi stock nahi, koi inventory nahi. Customer har mahine renew karte hain. Team dono taraf badhti hai, aur saara kaam phone se hota hai. Ek baat dhyan rahe — kamai sirf asli, paid subscriptions se hoti hai, aur kisi income ki guarantee nahi hai.

Ye product bechna aasaan hai. Har paid subscription par 2,500 BV banta hai. Subscription mahine ka hai — customer renew kare, to BV phir se banta hai. Aur registration hamesha free. Business waale apne phone par do minute ke demo mein iski value dekh lete hain — aur aapka apna card hi aapka demo hai.

Registration free hai, aur shuru mein aapki ID Red hoti hai. Red ID se team bana sakte hain, lekin pairs ka paisa nahi milta. Apna Growth plan lete hi ID Green ho jaati hai. Aapke paas left aur right, do joining link hote hain. Aur card ka link, pehle direct ko left, agle ko right, phir kamzor side par lagata hai. Jab koi aapke link se judkar subscribe karta hai, to aapko 25 AI credits referral bonus milta hai.

Kamai pairs par hoti hai. Left team mein 2,500 BV, aur right team mein 2,500 BV — ek pair, jiske 500 rupaye. Do binary hain — naye sale ki, aur renewal ki. Har binary mein din ke 10 pairs tak ki capping hai. Jo BV match nahi hota, woh aage carry hota hai. Aur har pair, pehle pair se hi, ek aur ek ka hai.

Ek example dekhiye. Priya Green hai. Shop A left mein judti hai — Priya ko 25 credits. Dr B right mein — ek pair, 500 rupaye aur 25 credits. Shop C left mein — 2,500 BV aage carry. Agle mahine A, B aur C renew karte hain — renewal ka ek pair, 500 rupaye. Aur jab Dr B ka customer D right mein judta hai, to carry hua BV pair bana deta hai — 500 rupaye. Ye sirf niyam samjhane ka example hai, income ka waada nahi.

Renewal binary kaise badhti hai? Maan lijiye Priya ki team mein har mahine do naye business judte hain, ek-ek dono taraf, aur sab renew karte rehte hain. Teesre mahine, pehle mahine ke do aur doosre mahine ke do — chaar business renew karte hain, yaani do renewal pairs. Isi tarah customer badhne ke saath renewal pairs badhte hain — lekin tabhi tak, jab tak customer renew karte rahein. Ye sirf ek maana hua udaharan hai.

Aur capping kya hai? Har binary mein din ke 10 pairs, yaani 5,000 rupaye tak. Poore mahine roz capping tak pahunchne ke liye, team mein us mahine lagbhag 600 naye paying business chahiye — 300 left, 300 right. Renewal binary mein bhi, itne hi business har mahine renew hone chahiye. Capping ek seema hai — target ya waada nahi.

Pairs se ranks bhi milti hain — dono binary ke lifetime pairs jodkar. Starter, 10 pairs par 1,000 rupaye, se lekar Crown, do lakh pairs par 50 lakh rupaye tak. Badi rewards monthly instalments mein milti hain, company ke monthly turnover ke 5 percent reward pool se.

Niyam likhit aur saaf hain. Matching roz raat hoti hai. Har Sunday ki closing ke baad, 500 rupaye ya usse zyada ka wallet apne aap payout ke liye jata hai, aur Wednesday ko bank mein transfer hota hai. Payout ke liye PAN aur bank ka KYC zaroori hai. TDS niyam ke hisaab se kat-ta hai, admin charge nahi. Aur income sirf asli sales se — sirf register karne ki koi income nahi.

Shuru kaise karein? Jisne aapko bulaya hai, unka link kholiye. Setup mein, Sell Shubhora as a partner chuniye, aur Make my Shubhora card dabaiye — aapka seller card taiyaar. Roz apna card share kariye. Aur Growth lete hi aapki ID Green ho jaati hai. App, shubhora dot com slash app se install kariye.
Apna poora business ek link par — aur use doosron tak pahuncha kar, apna business bhi. Aaj hi shubhora dot com par free register kariye. Koi sawaal ho, to jisne ye video bheja hai, unse poochiye.
